title: Limit message size
summary: WebSockets: Limit message size. Send only four bytes and add an echo handler to see it accepted.
introduction: maxPayload limits incoming message bytes. The client sends five bytes to a server limited to four.
learningObjectives: Send only four bytes and add an echo handler to see it accepted

blocks.text: Run npm init -y and npm install ws@8 in a practice folder. Save each example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. Each file starts a local server and test client, prints a result, then closes both.

blocks.title: Limit message size

blocks.text: Five text bytes exceed the four-byte receive limit. The server closes the connection with size-error code 1009.
Send only four bytes and add an echo handler to see it accepted.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Keep limits clear; a message that is too large is closed with a protocol size error.
